title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
正交脩庶明勵翼耳目淪浹心志純和君德成
而天命永屬人心永孚宗社生靈之久安長治
終必賴之矣斯其善計天下者哉此程子所爲
拳拳也今夫天下之事莫先定計計在一時者
功在一時計在萬世者功在萬世萬世之計非
可以易圖也則必於天下萬世之本圖之本者
何君是已蓋人君一身紹神靈之統總四海之
師宗廟社稷此其主鬯又將垂統於後而使千
百年此匕鬯也羣黎百姓此其託命又將傳嘉
===
師於後而使千百年此命脉也養則德否則否
德德則治否則不治治則宗社生靈久安不治
則常有不測之憂忽不自意之患是其所繫誠
重矣輔養之功其容已乎千金之家其家之老
誠愛其主而爲之念深遠計久長也則必使之
脩禮義以保其家於不衰然脩其禮義亦非徒
資之論說已也蓋必使常親善人聞善言見善
行而後禮義之行可成人君之身其所繫之重
何如也輔養君德其爲道之大又何如也而可
punctuated:
正交脩，庶明勵翼，耳目淪浹，心志純和。君德成而天命永屬，人心永孚，宗社生靈之久安長治，終必賴之矣。斯其善計天下者哉！此程子所爲拳拳也。

今夫天下之事，莫先定計。計在一時者，功在一時；計在萬世者，功在萬世。萬世之計，非可以易圖也，則必於天下萬世之本圖之。本者何？君是已。蓋人君一身，紹神靈之統，總四海之師。宗廟社稷，此其主鬯，又將垂統於後，而使千百年此匕鬯也；羣黎百姓，此其託命，又將傳嘉師於後，而使千百年此命脉也。養則德，否則否德；德則治，否則不治。治則宗社生靈久安，不治則常有不測之憂、忽不自意之患。是其所繫誠重矣，輔養之功，其容已乎？

千金之家，其家之老誠愛其主，而爲之念深遠、計久長也，則必使之脩禮義以保其家於不衰。然脩其禮義，亦非徒資之論說已也，蓋必使常親善人，聞善言，見善行，而後禮義之行可成。人君之身，其所繫之重何如也？輔養君德，其爲道之大又何如也？而可
translation_en:
… upright men cultivate one another, and all the enlightened officials exert themselves to assist him; his ears and eyes are steeped in goodness, and his mind and will become pure and harmonious. When the ruler's virtue is brought to completion, the Mandate of Heaven will forever belong to him, the hearts of the people will forever trust in him, and the lasting peace and enduring order of the ancestral temples, the altars of soil and grain, and the living souls will ultimately depend on this. Is this not what it means to plan well for the realm! This is why Master Cheng (Cheng Yi 程頤) was so earnestly devoted to it.

Now, in the affairs of the realm, nothing comes before establishing a plan. When a plan is for a single moment, its achievement lasts for a single moment; when a plan is for ten thousand generations, its achievement lasts for ten thousand generations. A plan for ten thousand generations cannot be easily devised; one must devise it at the very root of the realm for ten thousand generations. What is that root? It is none other than the ruler. Indeed, the ruler in his single person continues the succession of the sacred spirits and commands the multitudes of the Four Seas. For the ancestral temples and the altars of soil and grain, he is the presider over the sacrificial libations, and he will furthermore hand down the succession to posterity so that for hundreds and thousands of years these sacrificial ladles and libations are maintained. For the masses of the common people, he is the one to whom their lives are entrusted, and he will furthermore transmit the care of the fine multitudes to posterity so that for hundreds and thousands of years this lifeblood is preserved. If he is nourished, he will be virtuous; if not, he will lack virtue. If he is virtuous, there will be order; if not, there will be disorder. When there is order, the ancestral temples, the altars of soil and grain, and the living souls enjoy lasting peace; when there is disorder, there are constantly unpredictable anxieties and sudden, unexpected calamities. What depends on him is truly weighty indeed! Can the work of assisting and nourishing him be allowed to cease?

In a household of a thousand pieces of gold, if the elders of the house truly love their master and ponder deeply and plan for the long term on his behalf, they will surely cause him to cultivate ritual propriety and righteousness in order to preserve his household from decline. Yet cultivating ritual propriety and righteousness does not merely rely on discussions and explanations alone; rather, they must cause him constantly to be close to good men, hear good words, and see good deeds, and only then can the practice of ritual propriety and righteousness be accomplished. As for the person of the ruler, how much greater is the weight of what depends on him? And as for assisting and nourishing the ruler's virtue, how much greater is the magnitude of that Way? How then could one…

title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
以不密其功乎嘗觀自古大臣以忠事君固有
人而適之政而間之以為輔養者矣謂之曰弼
君之違奚不可也又有講說書史開發聰明以
為輔養者矣謂之曰引君於當道奚不可也然
以論諍而代薫陶則發而後禁不過匡救其末
取必於訓詁論說則心志雖勤而涵養觀感之
道容有未弘矧人君一身其環之於左右者甚
眾左右之人思以投間抵隙眩其聰明者甚工
吾以一人而言之言已而彼且詆之矣吾以古
===
今得失而陳說之說未已而彼且目攝之矣是
故沃心之益啟於一人而一傅羣咻亦不可不
慮也格心之功成於一旦而一暴十寒尤不可
不慮也是非過計也人之有性繇其所習習與
正人居不能無正故慎其左右前後疑丞弼直
之選而謹於朝夕燕閒起居出入之微誠不可
以已也此程子跬步不離正人之說所以拳拳
也昔者周統甫集而成王以冲年承之宗社生
靈其為岌岌何如也以太公為之師周公為之
punctuated: 以不密其功乎？嘗觀自古大臣以忠事君，固有人而適之、政而間之以為輔養者矣，謂之曰「弼君之違」，奚不可也？又有講說書史、開發聰明以為輔養者矣，謂之曰「引君於當道」，奚不可也？然以論諍而代薫陶，則發而後禁，不過匡救其末；取必於訓詁論說，則心志雖勤，而涵養觀感之道容有未弘。矧人君一身，其環之於左右者甚眾，左右之人思以投間抵隙、眩其聰明者甚工。吾以一人而言之，言已而彼且詆之矣；吾以古今得失而陳說之，說未已而彼且目攝之矣。是故沃心之益啟於一人，而一傅羣咻，亦不可不慮也；格心之功成於一旦，而一暴十寒，尤不可不慮也。是非過計也。人之有性，繇其所習；習與正人居，不能無正。故慎其左右前後疑、丞、弼、直之選，而謹於朝夕燕閒、起居出入之微，誠不可以已也。此程子「跬步不離正人」之說所以拳拳也。昔者周統甫集，而成王以冲年承之，宗社生靈，其為岌岌何如也！以太公為之師，周公為之
translation_en: …not make the effort thorough and meticulous? Looking at great ministers since antiquity who served their sovereigns with loyalty, there have certainly been those who reproved the men the ruler favored and criticized the policies he enacted as their means of assisting and nurturing him; to call this "correcting the sovereign's errors"—why would that be improper? There have also been those who expounded on classical texts and histories to enlighten his intelligence as their means of assisting and nurturing him; to call this "guiding the sovereign onto the proper Way"—why would that be improper? Yet if one substitutes remonstrance and debate for gradual moral molding, then forbidding a fault only after it has manifested does no more than remedy the superficial symptoms; and if one relies exclusively on textual explication and discourse, then although the mind and will may be diligent, the way of moral cultivation and inspiring emulation may still lack breadth. How much more so given that the sovereign's person is surrounded by a multitude of attendants, and those attendants are exceedingly adept at seeking out openings and exploiting crevices to dazzle and confuse his intelligence! If I speak to him alone as a single individual, no sooner have I finished speaking than they are already slandering my words; if I set forth an explanation of the successes and failures of past and present, before I have even finished explaining they are already exchanging intimidating glances to silence it. Therefore, when the benefit of enriching the sovereign's mind is initiated by a single person, one must not fail to worry about "one tutor teaching while a crowd jeers"; and when the achievement of rectifying the sovereign's mind is accomplished in a single morning, one must especially not fail to worry about "one day of sun exposure followed by ten days of frost." This is no excessive precaution. A person's character depends on what he is habituated to; when habituated to dwelling with upright men, one cannot help becoming upright. Thus, being circumspect in selecting the four close attendants—the Resolve-Doubts, the Assist, the Rectify, and the Upright—at his left and right, front and rear, and being heedful in the subtle details of his morning and evening leisure, his daily movements, and his goings and comings, truly cannot be dispensed with. This is why Master Cheng was so earnestly devoted to his dictum of "not departing from upright men by even half a pace." In antiquity, when the dynasty of Zhou had just consolidated its rule and King Cheng succeeded to it in his childhood years, how precarious was the state of the ancestral altars and the living people! With the Grand Duke (Taigong) as his Preceptor, the Duke of Zhou as his…

title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
傅召公爲之保史佚榮畢之徒莫不在列其輔
養之者亦靡不密矣而周公且抗世子法於伯
禽豈過計哉以爲論說之詳終不若觀感之切
也然猶未也立政之篇陳其知恤自常伯常任
準人之外首儆夫綴衣虎賁之臣而因及夫趣
馬小尹左右攜僕百司庶府之屬迺其槩之曰
庶常吉士又豈過計哉蓋使左右大小之臣莫
非吉士則日聞正言見正行而成王之耳目心
志莫非順正矣是故陳殷周興衰之端則有以
===
啓其敬德之念明文武創業之艱則可以作其
無逸之思下而至於卷阿之詠一遊息之間而
莫非用賢圖治之意尚有從于匪彝之失乎尚
有淫于觀于逸于遊于田之失乎故成王爲有
周令主而周公明保之功至於揚文武之烈和
恒四方之師以之億萬年敬天之休未艾也其
爲宗社生靈長乆之計孰有大於此者乎此固
萬世輔養君德之法程也此程子當時所以反
覆乎周公之事誠有味乎其言之也雖然輔養
punctuated: 傅、召公爲之保，史佚、榮、畢之徒莫不在列，其輔養之者亦靡不密矣。而周公且抗世子法於伯禽，豈過計哉？以爲論說之詳，終不若觀感之切也。然猶未也。《立政》之篇陳其知恤，自常伯、常任、準人之外，首儆夫綴衣、虎賁之臣，而因及夫趣馬、小尹、左右攜僕、百司、庶府之屬，迺其槩之曰「庶常吉士」，又豈過計哉？蓋使左右大小之臣莫非吉士，則日聞正言，見正行，而成王之耳目心志莫非順正矣。是故陳殷、周興衰之端，則有以啓其敬德之念；明文、武創業之艱，則可以作其無逸之思。下而至於《卷阿》之詠，一遊息之間，而莫非用賢圖治之意。尚有從于匪彝之失乎？尚有淫于觀、于逸、于遊、于田之失乎？故成王爲有周令主，而周公明保之功，至於揚文、武之烈，和恒四方之師，以之億萬年敬天之休未艾也。其爲宗社生靈長乆之計，孰有大於此者乎？此固萬世輔養君德之法程也。此程子當時所以反覆乎周公之事，誠有味乎其言之也。雖然，輔養
translation_en: …Junior Mentor, and the Duke of Shao (Shao gong) as his Junior Guardian, and with the likes of Scribe Yi (Shi Yi), Rong, and Bi all in attendance in the ranks, those who assisted and nurtured him left nothing unguarded in their thoroughness. Yet the Duke of Zhou still upheld the rules for a royal heir upon Boqin—was this an overly anxious precaution? He considered that detailed discourses and explanations are ultimately not as effective as direct observation and inspiration. Yet even that was not all. In the "Establishment of Government" (Lizheng) chapter [of the Book of Documents], in setting forth his knowing solicitude, aside from the Senators (changbo), Regular Overseers (changren), and Law Officials (zhunren), he first admonished the officials in charge of the Royal Robes (zhuiyi) and the Rapid as Tigers guard (huben), and thereby extended to the Equerries (zouma), Petty Chiefs (xiaoyin), personal attendants and grooms, the various officials, and the keepers of the treasuries, summarizing them all as "the numerous regular auspicious gentlemen" (shuchang jishi)—was this, too, an overly anxious precaution? Indeed, if the ministers at his side, great and small, were none other than auspicious gentlemen, then every day he would hear upright words and see upright conduct, and the ears, eyes, heart, and will of King Cheng would be entirely compliant and upright. Therefore, setting forth the beginnings of the rise and fall of Yin and Zhou served to awaken his mindfulness of revering virtue; clarifying the hardships of King Wen and King Wu in founding the dynasty served to rouse his thoughts Against Luxurious Ease (Wuyi). Coming down even to the singing of the "Curving Slope" (Juan'e) [in the Book of Odes], during a single moment of excursion and rest, there was nothing that was not intent upon employing the worthy and planning for good governance. Would there still be the fault of following improper norms? Would there still be the fault of excess in sightseeing, in ease, in excursion, or in hunting? Thus King Cheng became an exemplary ruler of the Zhou, and the achievement of the Duke of Zhou as his illustrious protector reached the point of exalting the meritorious deeds of Wen and Wu, harmonizing and stabilizing the multitudes of the four quarters, and thereby ensuring that for hundreds of millions of years the blessings of revering Heaven would never end. As a long-term plan for the ancestral altars and the living people, what could be greater than this? This is truly the model and standard for assisting and nurturing the sovereign's virtue for ten thousand generations. This is why Master Cheng (Chengzi) at that time repeatedly dwelt upon the deeds of the Duke of Zhou; there is truly deep meaning in his words! Even so, the work of assisting and nurturing…

title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
之功固不專於書史而使衆正在列亦未有廢
書史以爲功者昔傅說之告殷宗曰人求多聞
時惟建事學于古訓乃有獲蓋書史之間法戒
具焉誠時陳而時繹之能使人君瞿然顧化又
烏可以已哉唯取必於言說則不可耳故曰至
誠以感動之盡力以扶持之而明義理杜蔽惑
皆在至誠盡力之後然則輔養君德者其必有
以先之也已
表
===
擬宋行崇天萬年曆羣臣賀表〔慶曆元年〕
張潘

同考試官教授顧批事核詞工是長於四六者

punctuated:
之功，固不專於書史，而使衆正在列，亦未有廢書史以爲功者。昔傅說之告殷宗曰：「人求多聞，時惟建事；學于古訓，乃有獲。」蓋書史之間，法戒具焉。誠時陳而時繹之，能使人君瞿然顧化，又烏可以已哉？唯取必於言說，則不可耳。故曰：「至誠以感動之，盡力以扶持之。」而明義理、杜蔽惑，皆在至誠盡力之後。然則輔養君德者，其必有以先之也已。

慶曆元年某月某日，臣某等恭遇頒行崇天萬年曆者。伏以帝德統天，紹千聖欽崇之典；
translation_en:
… [Although the efficacy of] assisting and cultivating [the ruler's virtue] certainly does not lie exclusively in books and histories, even when placing a multitude of upright men at court, no one has ever succeeded by abandoning books and histories. Long ago, Fu Yue admonished King Gaozong of Yin, saying: "When a man seeks to hear much, it is in order to establish his affairs; by studying ancient lessons, one achieves gains." Indeed, within books and histories, both models to emulate and warnings to heed are fully present. If one truly sets them forth from time to time and explicates them continuously, they can cause the sovereign to be startled into reflection and transformation—how could one dispense with them? Only to rely exclusively on verbal instruction as a guaranteed means is impermissible. Therefore [Cheng Yi] said: "Move him with utmost sincerity, and support him with all one's strength." Clarifying moral principles and blocking out obscurations and delusions both come after utmost sincerity and exhausting one's strength. This being so, those who assist and cultivate the ruler's virtue must surely have what they put first!

title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
靈符啓運開萬年敬授之傳載纘
鴻圖
九重斂福聿新
鳳曆四海同春臣某等誠歡誠抃稽首頓首
竊惟曆象始於軒轅肇舉五辰之制璣衡
作於虞帝用昭七政之規欲若天以授人
必迎日而推筴自儀象旣失昆吾之學無
傳逮星紀一殽巫咸之術靡驗更四分於
李梵步算無稽衍五德於鄒生推占未協
===
歷代互相臆說術家雜著私書天高星遠
誠推測之爲難氣盈朔虛信揣摩之不易
玆蓋伏遇
〇〇〇〇
心涵太始
道格重玄
毓睿質於靑宮
紹洪休於紫極
財以不畜爲富四方被禹儉之風
punctuated: 靈符啓運，開萬年敬授之傳；載纘鴻圖，九重斂福；聿新鳳曆，四海同春。臣某等誠歡誠抃，稽首頓首。竊惟曆象始於軒轅，肇舉五辰之制；璣衡作於虞帝，用昭七政之規。欲若天以授人，必迎日而推筴。自儀象旣失，昆吾之學無傳；逮星紀一殽，巫咸之術靡驗。更四分於李梵，步算無稽；衍五德於鄒生，推占未協。歷代互相臆說，術家雜著私書。天高星遠，誠推測之爲難；氣盈朔虛，信揣摩之不易。玆蓋伏遇〇〇〇〇，心涵太始，道格重玄。毓睿質於靑宮，紹洪休於紫極。財以不畜爲富，四方被禹儉之風；
translation_en:
…and the numinous tally initiates the destiny, opening the tradition of reverently bestowing [the seasons] for ten thousand years. Continuing the grand enterprise, the ninefold palace gathers blessings; renewing the imperial calendar, all within the四海 (Four Seas) share in the spring. Your servants So-and-so and others, truly joyful and exultant, bow our heads to the ground.

We humbly reflect that calendrical astronomy began with Xuanyuan [the Yellow Emperor], who first instituted the system of the five temporal divisions; the armillary sphere and sighting tube were created by Emperor Yu [Shun], thereby illuminating the regularities of the Seven Regulators [sun, moon, and five planets]. Desiring to accord with Heaven in order to bestow the seasons upon the people, one must calculate forward to meet the sun and divine with yarrow stalks. Since the astronomical instruments and representations were lost, the learning of Kunwu was no longer transmitted; once the stellar markers fell into confusion, the arts of Wu Xian proved ineffective. When Li Fan revised the Quarter-Remainder [Sifen] calendar, his pacing and calculations were unfounded; when Master Zou [Zou Yan] elaborated the Five Virtues, his deductions and prognostications failed to harmonize. Through successive dynasties scholars offered mutual conjectures, and masters of technical arts promiscuously composed private books. Heaven is high and the stars are distant—truly, calculation and measurement are difficult; the solar periods have surpluses and the lunar months have deficits—indeed, fathoming them is not easy.

Now, we humbly encounter Your Majesty [〇〇〇〇], whose mind encompasses the Great Beginning, and whose Way reaches the Double Mystery. Having nurtured your sagely nature in the Eastern Palace, you succeeded to the vast blessings at the Purple Culmen [imperial throne]. Counting the non-accumulation of wealth as true riches, the four quarters are overspread by the wind of Yu's frugality; …

title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
兵以不試爲威萬國仰堯仁之化
凝圖撫運誕膺曆數之傳
議禮考文永作經綸之
主謂御曆必先治曆而明時乃可授時遡自
先朝迄無定議建隆而後襲欽天顯道之遺
興國以還用應天乾元之制處訥工於推
步宿度猶愆昭素審於均調歲差未定蓋
法不必於沿舊爰厪釐正之思而制有待
於更新用作調元之助
===
命張奎而造晷擇楚衍以同脩占歲占時在宋
行古能知其事求日求朔惟金克隆實董
其成議始於乾興之初功竣於天聖之歲
追大撓之遺軌考覈愈詳本一行之精思
推求益密東皇啓秘葭灰應玉管之調北
斗移春律呂協黃鍾之候交食交會之法
信而有徵應氣應閏之辰稽而不爽
龍章散彩爛然金檢之文
鳳藻騰輝宛矣玉衡之度儒臣製序臺正刊
punctuated: 兵以不試爲威，萬國仰堯仁之化。凝圖撫運，誕膺曆數之傳；議禮考文，永作經綸之主。謂御曆必先治曆，而明時乃可授時。遡自先朝，迄無定議。建隆而後，襲《欽天》、《顯道》之遺；興國以還，用《應天》、《乾元》之制。處訥工於推步，宿度猶愆；昭素審於均調，歲差未定。蓋法不必於沿舊，爰厪釐正之思；而制有待於更新，用作調元之助。命張奎而造晷，擇楚衍以同脩。占歲占時，在宋行古能知其事；求日求朔，惟金克隆實董其成。議始於乾興之初，功竣於天聖之歲。追大撓之遺軌，考覈愈詳；本一行之精思，推求益密。東皇啓秘，葭灰應玉管之調；北斗移春，律呂協黃鍾之候。交食交會之法，信而有徵；應氣應閏之辰，稽而不爽。龍章散彩，爛然金檢之文；鳳藻騰輝，宛矣玉衡之度。儒臣製序，臺正刊…
translation_en:
… and considers weapons majestic by leaving them unused, so that the myriad states look up to the transforming influence of Yao's benevolence. Consolidating the imperial plan and guiding the destiny of the realm, You have grandly received the transmission of the heavenly succession; deliberating on ritual and examining the written script, You forever serve as the sovereign who orders the state.

You hold that to reign over the dynasty one must first regulate the calendar, and that only by clarifying the seasons can one grant the seasons to the people. Tracing back through previous reigns, there had up to now been no settled consensus. After the Jianlong era (960–963), the legacy of the Qintian and Xiandao calendars was followed; from the Taiping Xingguo era (976–984) onward, the systems of the Yingtian and Qianyuan calendars were used. Though Wang Chune 王處訥 was skilled in astronomical calculation, the measurements of the lunar lodges still fell into error; though Wu Zhaosu 吳昭素 was careful in harmonizing and adjusting, the precession of the equinoxes remained undetermined. Indeed, since methods need not merely follow the old, You gave diligent thought to rectification; and since the system awaited renewal, it was to serve as an aid in harmonizing the primordial forces.

Thus You commanded Zhang Kui 張奎 to construct the sundial and selected Chu Yan 楚衍 to compile the calendar jointly. In prognosticating the year and the seasons, Song Xinggu 宋行古 was able to understand the affair; in seeking the solstices and the new moons, Jin Kelong 金克隆 truly supervised its completion. The deliberation began at the start of the Qianxing era (1022), and the work was completed in the years of the Tiansheng era (1023–1032). Pursuing the surviving tracks of Da Nao 大撓, the verification became ever more detailed; grounded in the subtle thought of Yi Xing 一行, the calculations grew increasingly precise. When the Lord of the East unlocks nature's secrets, the reed ashes respond to the tuning of the jade pitch-pipes; when the Northern Dipper shifts toward spring, the陰 and 陽 pitches harmonize with the season of the Yellow Bell (Huangzhong). The methods for calculating eclipses and syzygies are trustworthy and verifiable; the times corresponding to the solar terms and intercalary months are examined without the slightest discrepancy.

Imperial compositions scatter their splendor, brilliant as inscriptions on golden tablets; phoenix-like literary grace soars in radiance, exact as the measurements of the Jade Transverse. Scholar-officials composed the preface, and the Director of the Astronomical Bureau had it carved and…

title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
行本崇天以寓
敬天之心加萬年以昭
永年之慶四時順序元運重熈揭日月於中天
玉燭叶三靈而薦祉煥星辰於指掌璇穹
囿六合以迎祥草木生輝華夷胥慶臣等
幸逢
盛世樂遘
元辰方欣
景運之休隆復快
===
瑤圖之渙被敢不進時幾之戒期襄
台德於明明賡敕天之歌用賛
皇猷於赫赫伏願
配天行健
與日俱新孔固
皇圖永永歷無疆之甲子益崇
聖學駸駸懋方富之春秋布
正朔於萬方百蠻稽首奉
明威於一統四海傾心臣等無任瞻
punctuated: 行。本崇天以寓敬天之心，加萬年以昭永年之慶。四時順序，元運重熈。揭日月於中天，玉燭叶三靈而薦祉；煥星辰於指掌，璇穹囿六合以迎祥。草木生輝，華夷胥慶。臣等幸逢盛世，樂遘元辰。方欣景運之休隆，復快瑤圖之渙被。敢不進時幾之戒，期襄台德於明明；賡敕天之歌，用賛皇猷於赫赫？伏願配天行健，與日俱新。孔固皇圖，永永歷無疆之甲子；益崇聖學，駸駸懋方富之春秋。布正朔於萬方，百蠻稽首；奉明威於一統，四海傾心。臣等無任瞻
translation_en:
… for publication. Named "Venerating Heaven" (Chongtian) to embody a heart that reveres Heaven, it adds "Ten Thousand Years" (Wannian) to manifest the blessing of eternal longevity. The four seasons proceed in proper sequence, and the primordial destiny shines anew. Holding aloft the sun and moon in mid-heaven, the jade-like harmony brings the three numinous powers into accord to present blessings; illuminating the stars and constellations upon the palm of the hand, the jeweled vault encompasses the six directions to welcome good fortune. Plants and trees take on a vibrant glow, and Chinese and foreign peoples alike rejoice.

Your servants are fortunate to encounter a flourishing age and delighted to meet with this auspicious New Year's Day. Just as we rejoice in the glorious prosperity of the great destiny, we further take pleasure in the widespread bestowal of the precious almanac. How could we dare not offer the admonition to attend to the timely and the subtle, hoping to assist Your exalted virtue in its radiant brightness, and continue the song of "obeying the ordinances of Heaven" so as to aid the imperial plan in its resplendent majesty?

We humbly pray that You may match Heaven in its unceasing vigor and renew Yourself daily along with the sun. May You firmly consolidate the imperial domain, eternally passing through boundless sixty-year cycles; and ever more esteem sage learning, briskly striving forward in the prime of Your years. As You promulgate the orthodox calendar to the myriad regions, the hundred barbarian tribes bow their heads to the ground; as they revere Your glorious majesty within the grand unity, the four seas turn their hearts in submission. Your servants cannot contain the utmost…

title: 萬曆元年浙江鄉試錄
text:
天仰
聖歡抃踴躍之至謹奉
表稱
賀以
聞

策

沈堯中
===
同考試官教諭翟批我
皇上心學之傳遠紹聖哲嘉納忠猷千載一時也子獨能敷陳而揚厲之可
以觀靖獻之忱矣
同考試官教授張批
明良交孚之意是篇模寫精詳揄揚殆盡可錄
考試官教授萬批忠愛藹然

執事首策諸生而以

punctuated:
天仰聖、歡抃踴躍之至，謹奉表稱賀以聞。

第叁場
策
第一問
沈堯中
同考試官教諭翟批：我皇上心學之傳，遠紹聖哲，嘉納忠猷，千載一時也。子獨能敷陳而揚厲之，可以觀靖獻之忱矣。

translation_en:
… looking up to Heaven and revering the Sage, and are filled to the utmost with joyful elation and leaping delight. We respectfully present this memorial of congratulation for Your Majesty's hearing.

Third Session
Policy Essays
First Question
Shen Yaozhong 沈堯中

You alone have been able to set this forth and extol it; from this one can see the sincerity of your quiet devotion to the throne.
